_doc: Data for thankmu/patch_extension.py. Placeholders {name} {short_name} {description} {author} {homepage_url} {support_url} {privacy_url} {credit} are filled from brand.json. Every pattern must match exactly the stated count, else the build fails (a new upstream string is a failure, never a silent leak).

*.supportS3P1: Report filter issues with specific websites on the {name} support page.
*.supportS6P1S1: Please verify that the issue has not already been reported. Note: clicking the button will cause the page's origin to be sent to the {name} support page.

_ruleset_display_ids_doc: Internal ruleset ids stay as upstream has them (rulesets, manifest, settings and storage are byte-identical). These are remapped for DISPLAY only, at the two points where an id becomes visible: the troubleshooting text (js/troubleshooting.js, shown on the About pane and report page and sent in the report URL) and the ruleset export file name (js/ro-dnr-editor.js). Keys must be real ruleset ids; the build fails if one vanishes or if a new upstream id carries an upstream mark and is missing here (the brand scan).

ruleset_details._doc: homeURL_on_mark: a list homepage that points at an upstream site is dropped ('remove') or sent to the brand homepage ('brand_homepage'). Dropping is the honest default: ThankMu does not maintain those lists.

edits._doc: W-P6: the D2 popup's header and stats, framed above upstream's site controls (the second frame, below them, is the last edit). The frames size their own height (js/thankmu/popupfit.js). min-width 32.5rem (520px): the narrowest width at which every state fits Chrome's 600 px popup, with upstream's custom-filter row and the 16 px text floor (compact follow-up, docs/rebrand.md "Popup (W-P6)").

about_license._doc: W-P4: the modification notice (GPLv3 5(a)), the GPLv3 notice and source offer on the About pane, inserted right after the credit rows (after: the rendered lists_credit row, which must exist exactly once). with_source is used when the build target has targets.json source_url, without_source (dev only: a store target without source_url fails the build) otherwise. {source_url} comes from the target; everything else from brand.json. LICENSE.txt is upstream's GPLv3 text, shipped in the package. The brand scan requires exactly this rendering once. license_file: the licence text the notice links; it must be in the package (checked by the patch step and both package checks).
about_license.with_source:
{modification_notice}
{license_notice} {license_link_text}
{source_offer} {source_url}

layer._doc: W-P3 part B: ThankMu's own code, injected as NEW files (never overwriting an upstream one). files are copied from src at the same path; .html files get the brand placeholders filled. config_module is generated from thankmu/targets.json for the build target (APP_ORIGIN). The manifest's background.service_worker moves from upstream to the wrapper, which imports the ThankMu module first and upstream's worker second, so js/background.js stays byte-identical. Collocated *.test.mjs files are not listed and never ship.
layer._css_modules_doc: W-P4 design handoff: the design tokens (css/thankmu-tokens.css, the handoff's tokens.css unchanged) reach the ad-slot card inside its closed shadow root as a string. A content script cannot import CSS and the card must not make any extension file web-accessible, so the patch step inlines the file into a generated classic script (to) that sets globalThis.ThankMuTokensCss in the content script's isolated world. Only the :root and .theme-dark selectors are rewritten, to scope (the card's own element), because they match nothing inside a shadow root. The popup frame and the account page load the same file with a plain <link>. The fonts are for those two extension pages only (their own @font-face); the card keeps the token font stack's system fallback.
layer._content_scripts_doc: W-T1 part A: appended to the manifest's content_scripts (upstream's entries, if any, untouched). Each js must be one of layer.files. Top frame only; matches are http and https pages.

icons._doc: Each upstream img/icon_<size>[_off].png is regenerated from brand.json icon_source at the same size. Unknown icon names fail the build.
